title: Cut Wall Cavity Vacuuming in Water Damage Mitigation Final Cleaning
content:
In the final cleaning of a Water Damage Mitigation job, cut wall cavities are vacuumed up to the cut, adding a vacuumed wall area to the final HEPA vacuuming line.

## Standard
Cut wall cavities are vacuumed up to the cut: on a Category 3 job carrying flood cut lines the vacuumed wall area is the linear feet on its flood cut lines times 4 feet, on a Category 2 job carrying flood cut lines it is those linear feet times 2 feet, and in any other case no cut-cavity wall area is vacuumed under this standard.

## Table
| IICRC water category on the job | Flood cut lines | Vacuumed wall area |
|---|---|---|
| Category 3 | yes | flood cut linear feet multiplied by 4 feet |
| Category 2 | yes | flood cut linear feet multiplied by 2 feet |
| Category 1 | yes | none under this standard |
| any | no | none under this standard |

## Worked figures (hypothetical flood cut run of 135 linear feet)
- Category 3: 540 square feet of vacuumed wall area.
- Category 2: 270 square feet.
